standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-th.npc: Thank you for helping me. A golem can have no greater satisfaction than knowing that its task is complete.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-th.player: But the whole city is destroyed! Doesn't that bother you?

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-th.npc: I was never programmed to appreciate the city. My only purpose was the destruction of the demon, and that is achieved!

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-sh.npc: I regret that I could not assist you in the slaying of Agrith-Naar.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-sh.player: Don't worry, golem! You've done enough demon-slaying in your time.
